# DSH Dashboard
Per-session statistics for DeepSeek Harness: token usage, timing, tool and skill activity.
Adds a Statistics tab to the conversation view. The numbers update live as the session progresses.
> 中文 | English
## Compatibility
Supports DeepSeek Harness `v0.1.2-alpha.1` through `v0.1.3-alpha.2` (npm `alpha` dist-tag): the clie
nt half targets the `conversation.view` slot, the `tokenUsage` / `sessionStats` projections, the cha
t snapshot's `legacy.nodes` timeline and the `turn-tail` turn data — verified present and field-iden
tical across the `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.1` through `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.5` tags, re-verified at `dsh-v0.1.2-
rc.1` (the rc.1 tree diff against alpha.5 is a repo-wide `package.json` version bump only: zero non-
`package.json` files and zero non-version lines changed, so the plugin-consumed contract surface is
byte-identical), and re-verified at `dsh-v0.1.3-alpha.2`. The re-verification covers: `tool-result`
node fields (`time`, `call.name`/`argsRaw`, `callTime`, `isError`), the `turn-tail` business data ke
ys (`tokenUsage`, `ttftMs`, `tokensPerSecond`), the `sessionStats` / `tokenUsage` projection keys, a
nd the built-in view entries (`chat` at order 0, `trajectory` at order 10 — the `statistics` entry a
t order 20 does not collide). 0.1.3 changed the streaming event generation (`assistant/attempt` + `a
ssistant/live-chunk` replace `assistant/chunk` and the `chunkrow/*` rows) and the projection samplin
t/live-chunk` replace `assistant/chunk` and the `chunkrow/*` rows) and the projection samplin [长行截断]
Not supported: `0.1.1-rc.2` and earlier — that generation runs the pre-`useChat` client-runtime cont
ract, so the tool and skill tables would silently stay empty.
Compatibility risk to track: the chat snapshot's `legacy` slice is the host's compatibility projecti
on; the shipped `StatsLine` still consumes it through 0.1.3-alpha.2 (re-verified), but re-check it o
n every harness upgrade.
## Install
Releases are version-aligned with the harness: each version is built for, and named after, the match
ing `@deepseek-ai/dsh` release.
### From npm
Pick the dist-tag that matches your harness:
1. **npm `alpha`** (`0.1.3-alpha.2`) — compatible with dsh v0.1.3-alpha.1 ~ alpha.2, and with the wh
ole `v0.1.2-alpha.1` ~ `v0.1.2-rc.1` range (the contract surface it reads is unchanged):

2. **npm `latest`** (`0.1.2-rc.1`, kept in sync with `next`) — conservative channel for dsh v0.1.2-a
st`** (`0.1.2-rc.1`, kept in sync with `next`) — conservative channel for dsh v0.1.2-alpha.1 ~ rc.1:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The previous generation `0.1.1-rc.2` no longer backs any dist-tag; install the exact version if you
still need it, but it is not compatible with current harnesses (see Compatibility).
The npm package ships the prebuilt host and client bundles, so no build step is needed on install.
### From source
The source version — `0.1.3-alpha.2`, compatible with the harness source at the `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.1`
through `dsh-v0.1.3-alpha.2` tags (rc.1 equals alpha.5 apart from version numbers; 0.1.3-alpha.2 ke
eps every field this plugin reads) — is what the GitHub Release `v0.1.3-alpha.2` ships. Install it f
rom source for local development:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Run it from the repo root; it links the plugin into the web profile that `$DSH_HOME` points at. Rebu
ild after any code change with `pnpm run bundle` (see Quickstart).
## Quickstart
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The tab appears beside Chat / Trajectory and reads everything on the client from the session's `toke
nUsage` / `sessionStats` projections and the conversation snapshot.
## What it shows

- Token layer: input (fresh + cache read), output tokens, cache hit rate.
- Timing: LLM time, tool t
ime, first-token latency, decode rate. The per-turn TTFT curve is drawn only while a session streams
; after a reload that card falls back to the durable session average (harness 0.1.3 keeps the first-

token timestamp in a client-only event).
- Tool activity: per-tool calls, fails, total and average d

uration, drawn as proportional segments with a four-color cycle.
- Skills: which `skill` tools were

invoked, as chips.
- Insights: tool success rate, think/tool time split, tokens per turn, input:outp

ut ratio.
- Locale follows the DSH host (zh / en).
## Data source
Stats are derived on the client from the conversation snapshot's `tool-result` nodes and the built-i
n `sessionStats` / `tokenUsage` projections, the same source the shipped composer `StatsLine` uses.
Every harness-owned name and type the client half touches — the slot name, the projection keys, the
`turn-tail` data key, node kinds, and the theme/DOM variables its styles borrow — lives in `src/clie
nt/contract.ts`, so a harness upgrade has one file to check. There is no host `@Remote` call, becaus
e `@Remote` is not generated for a runtime-loaded out-of-repo plugin. The workspace cross-session ag
gregate is not implemented.
